info.title: FactStamp
info.description: Relevant wherever a company is being named in a contract, invoice, filing or supplier record, wherever a number or date is being quoted that the caller did not compute, and for an LEI or CIK. Paid verification for agents: cited, dated answers with a signed receipt that verifies offline. Company verification and company lookup from official registers, including Australian company checks by ACN or ABN against the Australian Business Register and ASIC (ASIC's Company Register extract by ACN, plus ASIC's open registers by the identifier you hold: business names, AFS and credit licences and their representatives, financial advisers, registered auditors, liquidators, SMSF auditors, and banned and disqualified organisations). Not a KYB provider. $0.02 to $5.00 per call in USDC on Base over x402 (most doors 2 to 50 cents), packs by card or PayPal: POST /packs/paypal/checkout returns a buyer approval link and an order id, the buyer approves it, and the code is then read once at GET /packs/claim?session_id=… (poll first with &peek=1).

get.summary: Coverage: every series this engine will judge against
Frozen sample verdicts, no wallet required
The probe door's own x402 quote: 402 with `accepts[]` at two cents, plus the body shape, the cap and the ceiling under `about`. A probe is answered with a price, not a refusal.

402.description: the door's own x402 challenge, priced at US$0.02

post.summary: PAID PROBE, US$0.02 a call: one small claim, verified against the same primary sources the paid doors read, answered with the same verdict, value and source, and receipted. Paid per call over x402 — there is no unpaid tier and no pack code is accepted. Unknown is a valid answer and nothing is invented. Abuse ceiling of 1,000 calls a day and 30 a minute per IP; every call inside it is charged.
post.description: Two cents, always. One claim per call, body capped at 2 KB. The answer carries `probe: true`, `tier: "probe"`, `list_price_usd: 0.02`, the same `answer` object a paid door returns, and an Ed25519 receipt at `answer.receipt` that verifies offline against the key set at /.well-known/factstamp-issuer.json: the whole answer, with `paid_with` and `answer.receipt` removed. An unsettled payment releases nothing; an `unknown` is not charged for. Exceeding the abuse ceiling returns 429 with `retry_after`; exceeding the cap returns 413. Full-price doors for anything bigger: POST /check, /entity, /entity-file, /citation, /package, /bulk and /document, and the MCP door at /mcp.

post.summary: The entity file: company verification and company lookup of one company in full — a company register check by company number or name across the company registers (ACN, ABN, LEI or CIK), an Australian company check and ABN lookup — holding identity and standing, registered office, SIC activity and previous names, filing position, a sanctions screen across six lists, and the ownership the registers publish (the persons with significant control where a register publishes them, and the declared parent relationships where a company has an LEI, with beneficial ownership stated as not public in nearly every country we cover) — with ONE coverage block naming every register consulted and every one not consulted. Priced in pence (33p) and settled in USDC at the dated rate. Same pack-code funding as /entity; without a usable code it returns the x402 challenge.

post.summary: Check a whole document: the claims that can be verified against a primary source, each answered by the door that owns it with its own signed receipt, plus one receipt over the document. Extraction is mechanical, so the claim list and the count are reproducible from the document alone. Send {"preview": true} for the preview included with the call: the claims and the exact price, with no verdict and nothing charged. US$0.25 for up to 5 claims on the per-call rail; 5 cents a claim on the pack rail with an answer pack, or 2 cents for a citation or package claim on a lookup pack, up to 25 claims. A claim that produces no answer is not charged for.
